# Right panel: drag-resize, remembered width, tabs, full-screen sheet on narrow screens

## What to build

The side panel (`aside#panel`) on both pages has a fixed width today: `#main.withpanel { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) min(520px,45vw) }`. It also stacks its sections vertically:

- run page: header, info, actions, failure section, totals, files with inline diffs
- suite page: the same plus agent logs

This slice turns it into a real **right panel**, through a shared module `src/web/assets/panel.js`:

- **Drag-resize** from its left edge, with a 6px handle (`.panel-resize`, `role="separator"`, `aria-orientation="vertical"`, `aria-valuenow`), pointer capture, and a visible 2px accent line on hover.
  - The width is clamped to 320px … 85% of the viewport.
  - Double-clicking the handle resets it to 640px.
  - When the handle has focus, ArrowLeft/Right resize in 32px steps.
- **Remembered**: `{width, open, tab}` is saved in `localStorage['ge.panel']` (try/catch) and restored on load.
- **Push, not overlay**: the panel is a grid column, so the canvas shrinks. `createCanvas`'s ResizeObserver refits the graph.
- **Header**: the node or feature title, a status chip, and a close button (×). `Esc` closes the panel (ignored while typing).
- **Tabs**: `Overview · Changes · Logs`.
  - Overview: the existing info, actions (Retry, Merge as it is…) and failure section.
  - Changes: the existing totals and files with diffs.
  - Logs: the suite page's existing agent logs. On the run page it is an empty placeholder ("Logs coming soon") until the logs slice.
  - The selected tab is remembered per page.
- **Narrow screens (< 900px)**: the panel becomes a fixed full-screen sheet over the canvas, with a "← Graph" back button instead of the resize handle.

The previous slices delivered:

- `/assets/*` on both servers, `theme.css`, `graph.js` (`createCanvas` with a ResizeObserver refit), and `diff.js` (`renderDiff`, with data attributes on rows)
- the full-viewport shell from `src/web/assets/shell.js`/`shell.css`: `#topbar`, `#main` holding the canvas and the phase stepper, `#drawer`, and the summary card. Review is still a left overlay card inside `#main`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/web/page.html`:
  - the `#main` / `#panel` CSS (search `withpanel`)
  - `renderPanel(s)` (search `function renderPanel`): it shows or hides `#panel`, toggles `#main.withpanel`, and rebuilds the sections when the selected node changes
  - `failureSection`, `loadDiff`, `makeRow`, `updateRow`, `renderPlan`
  - the graph click handler in `main()` that sets `selected`
- `src/suite/page.html`:
  - `pnl` state, `featureOf`, `logSource`, `loadLogs`, `loadDiff`, `makeRow`, `updateRow`, `setSection`, `DESCRIBE`, `infoOf`, `renderPanel`
  - the panel close logic (search `panel.hidden = true`)
- `src/web/assets/shell.js`: the `createDrawer` drag code, as a pattern for pointer capture plus localStorage.

## Patterns to follow

**Module API:**
```js
// @ts-check
/** Pure: clamps a requested width to [320, 0.85*viewport]. */
export function clampWidth(w, viewport) { return Math.round(Math.min(Math.max(w, 320), Math.floor(viewport * 0.85))); }
/** Pure: reads {width, open, tab} from a JSON string; defaults on any error. */
export function readPanelState(text) { /* {width:640, open:false, tab:"overview"} */ }

/** @returns {{open(title, statusChip), close(), setTab(name), tab(name): HTMLElement, onClose(fn), onTab(fn), el: HTMLElement}} */
export function createPanel(mainEl, { storageKey = "ge.panel", tabs = ["overview", "changes", "logs"] } = {}) { /* ... */ }
```
- The panel sets `mainEl.style.gridTemplateColumns = \`minmax(0,1fr) ${width}px\`` when it is open, and `1fr` when it is closed.
- Each tab is a scrollable container (`overflow:auto; min-height:0`). The page's render code fills `panel.tab("changes")` etc.

**Keep incremental updates.** Both pages update file rows in place (`updateRow`) and must not rebuild a tab on every state message. Keep that behaviour: only rebuild when the selected node changes.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `src/web/assets/panel.js` and `src/web/assets/panel.css`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `clampWidth`, `readPanelState`, `createPanel` (handle, keyboard, double-click reset, persistence, tabs, the `Esc` key, the narrow-mode media query `(max-width: 899px)` that switches to a sheet with "← Graph"), and the CSS (glass panel, `backdrop-filter: var(--blur)`, a tab bar with an accent underline, a handle hover line).
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets` (a `panel.test.ts` for `clampWidth` and `readPanelState`)

### UPDATE `src/web/page.html`

- **IMPLEMENT**: replace the `aside#panel` handling with `createPanel(document.getElementById("main"))`.
  - Selecting a node calls `panel.open(title, status)` and fills Overview (info, actions, failure section, test plan) and Changes (totals and files with `renderDiff`).
  - Logs gets a placeholder.
  - Closing the panel clears the selection.
  - Delete the old `withpanel` CSS.
- **VALIDATE**: build, then agent-browser: open a node, drag the handle to about 75% (`agent-browser` mouse drag, or `eval` that dispatches pointer events), reload, and the width is kept. Then a narrow check (`agent-browser set viewport 800 900`).

### UPDATE `src/suite/page.html`

- **IMPLEMENT**: the same, with the suite's existing logs moved into the Logs tab (`loadLogs` renders into `panel.tab("logs")`).
- **VALIDATE**: build, then `demo/suite/run.sh`, with agent-browser screenshots of the panel at a wide width and of the narrow sheet.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] On both pages, clicking a node opens the right panel with Overview / Changes / Logs tabs
- [ ] Dragging the handle resizes the panel between 320px and 85% of the viewport; double-click resets it to 640px; the arrow keys resize it
- [ ] Width, open state and tab survive a reload
- [ ] The canvas shrinks and refits when the panel opens or resizes
- [ ] `Esc` and × close the panel
- [ ] Under 900px the panel is a full-screen sheet with "← Graph"
- [ ] Retry and "Merge as it is" still work from Overview (TESTING.md failed-run script)
- [ ] `npm test` passes, and agent-browser screenshots (wide panel, narrow sheet, both pages) are in the report

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/web
npm run build
```
